title: Full gate: run the UI test stage concurrently with Rust tests when host resources allow, keeping one exact-input gate
outcome: Full gate: run the UI test stage concurrently with Rust tests when host resources allow, keeping one exact-input gate
acceptance: The full gate can run the vitest stage concurrently with the rust-tests stage without changing either stage's selection or coverage, and the result still records one exact input with matching before and after fingerprints
A measured comparison on the same host and input shows the wall-time change and the CPU, RAM and I/O contention effects; no saving is claimed without that measurement
Fixture isolation holds under concurrency: no shared temp, port or store path between the stages, proven by a test or by the measured run's clean residual census
A failure in either stage is reported with that stage's own result, and the other stage's result is not lost
